verdict.rationale:
Superset lets a developer resume or redirect an in-progress agent via terminal (persistent background terminal sessions, agent-status 'waiting for input' notifications) and via browser (diff viewer, PR review comments sent to a running agent, Design pane element-based feedback, automations that produce a live workspace you can open and continue interactively). No evidence describes a dedicated editor/IDE integration for taking over a running task, only CLI/terminal and browser UI channels.
missing for 10: explicit editor/IDE takeover flow, independent hands-on confirmation of mid-task redirection working smoothly.
